name: The Living Room
containment: SCP-002 is to remain connected to a suitable power supply at all times. In case of electrical outage, emergency barriers must be activated and the surrounding area evacuated.
description: SCP-002 resembles a tumorous fleshy growth containing an interior similar to a low-rent apartment. Furniture inside appears to be created from biological materials.
reference: The object has been responsible for the disappearance of several personnel and continues to alter its interior.

name: Biological Motherboard
containment: SCP-003 must be maintained at a constant temperature above 35°C. Living organisms of high complexity must not come into contact with SCP-003.
description: SCP-003 consists of two related components. SCP-003-1 resembles a biological motherboard made from chitin, hair and nails.
reference: The object demonstrates unknown biological and technological properties.

name: The Door and Twelve Keys
containment: SCP-004 keys must only be handled by authorised personnel. Keys must not be removed without proper security approval.
description: SCP-004 consists of an old wooden door and twelve rusted keys. Different keys create different spatial and temporal effects.
reference: Testing revealed that SCP-004 creates unknown dimensional spaces.

name: Skeleton Key
containment: Approval from Level 4 personnel is required before removing SCP-005 from containment.
description: SCP-005 resembles an ornate key with the ability to open almost any mechanical or digital lock.
reference: Further experiments suggest SCP-005 may possess limited intelligence.

name: Fountain of Youth
containment: Personnel interacting with SCP-006 must follow strict security procedures.
description: SCP-006 is a small spring producing liquid with unusual healing properties.
reference: The liquid increases cellular regeneration and improves immune system effectiveness.
